name: Cefalexin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Adults and children 15 years or older
usual_adult_dose.dose: 250 mg every 6 hours or 500 mg every 12 hours for 7 to 14 days
Up to 4 g/day in 2 to 4 divided doses
30–59: max 1 g/day; 15–29: 250 mg every 8–12 hours; 5–14: 250 mg every 24 hours; 1–4: 250 mg every 48–60 hours

key_interactions.effect: Higher metformin levels; lower metformin renal clearance (label).
Blocks tubular secretion; higher and longer drug levels (label).

serious: Anaphylaxis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis
Seizures in kidney impairment without dose reduction

contraindications: Known allergy to cephalexin or other cephalosporins

pk.peak: About 9, 18 and 32 mcg/mL at 1 hour after 250 mg, 500 mg and 1 g
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Over 90% unchanged in urine within 8 hours (filtration and tubular secretion)

sources.citation: Ascend Laboratories, LLC. (2026). Cephalexin tablets, USP [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, ANDA218947, set ID 36882c6d-7b6f-41e3-8c54-e3b0073b8c07, version effective October 16, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
